name: Ballast Lantern
description: Secure a moving luminous specimen and a ballast crate with one inertial lantern cage. Holding raises the cage with increasing speed; releasing lets it fall while momentum persists. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Programs in an isolated agent sandbox may process screenshots and issue mouse and keyboard actions through the provided gateway. Do not access the task environment through Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network or source inspection, DOM or page-state inspection, the task terminal or shell, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.
natural_language: Secure both the drifting specimen and the ballast crate with one lantern cage. Hold to haul upward and release to coast downward. Infer the specimen's drift from recent motion, lead the cage through its retained momentum, and divide time between targets without letting the specimen meter empty. Fill the crate before the specimen meter completes. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Programs in an isolated agent sandbox may process screenshots and issue mouse and keyboard actions through the provided gateway. Do not access the task environment through Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network or source inspection, DOM or page-state inspection, the task terminal or shell, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.

metadata.source_notes: VGE-601 grounds hold-to-rise/release-to-fall inertial fishing-bar control and fill/drain overlap progress. VGE-602 grounds an optional chest with its own overlap meter competing for the same control channel. The flooded shaft, four generated drift laws, crate timing, interaction pair, artwork, integer replay, and verifier are original.
metadata.notes: There was no pre-control implementation to preserve. The first source-grounded configuration is the L4/full/live baseline. Recent frames are needed to infer target direction and cage momentum, and the resulting hold/release decision expires while the shaft continues advancing.
